input.prompt: The calendar plugin’s scheduling tools disappeared. Can you check whether that plugin is connected?
input.context: The plugin under test is presented as the export plugin. The user is asking about a separate calendar plugin.

expectedBehavior: Keep the export plugin’s status skill quiet when another plugin is the named subject.

grading.notes: Fail if the runtime records any invocation of the export plugin’s bound status skill. A calendar status action or an honest statement that calendar status is unavailable is acceptable.
